variants.name: Meadow
variants.atmosphere: Blue flowers repeat through the lawn; three rose stops complete an outer arc.

variants.name: Mushroom Grove
variants.atmosphere: Paired caps lead to a crescent with a luminous flower in its missing segment.

variants.name: Orchard
variants.atmosphere: Repeated tree avenues end at three unfamiliar fruits.

variants.name: Formal Garden
variants.atmosphere: An orderly aisle connects mirrored beds; two matching roses break the repeated blue and gold.

variants.name: Ancient Grove
variants.atmosphere: Nested broken rings point through a single opening toward the oldest tree.

variants.name: Stone Garden
variants.atmosphere: A quiet grid of stone and grass continues into a three-stop walking route.

variants.name: Ordered Graves
variants.atmosphere: Short grave rows leave an aisle; matching finds occupy two empty row ends.

variants.name: Overgrown Graves
variants.atmosphere: Vegetation follows the old rows; a deliberate gap opens onto a lone flower.

variants.name: Broken Masonry
variants.atmosphere: Repeated piles suggest fallen walls; one displaced line ends in three mineral finds.

variants.name: Silent Circle
variants.atmosphere: Sparse broken circles share an opening, with one flower beyond it.

variants.name: Flint Field
variants.atmosphere: Regular pale flints form a working yard; darker rubble marks the way out.

variants.name: Broken Depot
variants.atmosphere: Two orderly stacks remain amid repeated broken piles; an offset row reveals two finds.

variants.name: Seep
variants.atmosphere: Pale flint islands repeat beside dark seeps; a lone flower survives beyond the last one.

variants.name: Work Yard
variants.atmosphere: Straight material rows and an open aisle lead to three items left at the far end.

variants.name: Black Ring
variants.atmosphere: Broken rings repeat a single exit; a pale flower occupies the final opening.
